notes:
Top-line: Mid-market sales engagement SaaS (CloseFlow) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for outbound SDR agents. Primary need: low-latency streaming + tool calling to perform CRM/email/calendar actions in real-time. Goal: start on Hosted API POC, then move to Dedicated if latency/cost profile meets SLOs.

Recent calls:
- 2025-11-12 discovery call (AE Samira P.) - demo of Redwood streaming; customer asked about p95 latency and KV cache behavior.
- 2025-11-28 demo with engineering (SE Diego R.) - walked through tool-calling flow: create_contact, log_email, schedule_meeting. SE asked about auth model for write actions.
- 2025-12-02 security sync - legal requested data residency guarantees and audit log retention policy.

Requirements:
- Workload: high-volume outbound chat agents (SDR) with streaming responses to increase responsiveness and agent throughput.
- Latency: target <200ms p95 for streaming responses, <100ms for token generation within local region.
- Throughput: 200 concurrent agents initially; scale to 1000 agents during peak.
- Tool calling: CRM writes (create/update contact), send outbound emails, calendar invites. Need secure token exchange and per-action audit logs.
- Model preferences: prefer mlc/Redwood-verified Llama 2 variants or equivalent open models; open to proprietary if SLA met.
- Routing/fallback: Hosted primary, Dedicated for predictable latency and bulk throughput; fall back to smaller model variant if capacity constrained.
- Security: SSO/SAML, KMS for keys, retention controls, SOC2-compatible audit logs, optional regional data residency.

POC scope:
- 2-week Hosted API POC: integrate streaming + tool-calling prototype (connect to sandbox CRM), run 200 concurrent agents for 1 hour load test, capture p50/p95 latency.
- If p95 <200ms and cost within estimate move to Dedicated pricing discussion.
